description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Azizi Milan by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential destination in City of Arabia, Dubailand, inspired by the timeless elegance of Italian architecture and design. Drawing inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the development blends distinctive architectural character with modern urban living. Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. The amenities at Lunara Tower are thoughtfully gathered on a complete rooftop level, creating a vibrant social hub for residents to enjoy. The rooftop features a stunning swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium, a serene spa, and a beautifully appointed co-working space for those who work from home. Residents also enjoy a games room, a kids' play area, a multipurpose hall, a barbecue area, a padel court, and an amenities reception, ensuring that relaxation, wellness, productivity, and connection are all effortlessly catered for within the building. Each home is delivered fully furnished with premium finishes, ensuring that residents can immediately immerse themselves in the comfort and elegance of their new home, while the chamfered corners and clear glazing articulate the building's presence on its three street frontages with quiet distinction. Residents benefit from proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and Downtown district, Dubai Marina Mall, and Dubai International Airport, making both business and leisure effortlessly accessible. For global travel, Al Maktoum International Airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring that the world is always close at hand. The surroundings offer a wealth of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that enrich daily life, from world-class shopping destinations to vibrant cultural and leisure attractions. The area's continued growth and investment in infrastructure signal a bright future, making it an increasingly attractive choice for homeowners and investors seeking both comfort and long-term value. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it provides breathtaking waterfront views and easy access to major landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente - the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

This high-end residential development is located in Dubai's distinctive Al Jaddaf district, a strategic location in the heart of the city that combines excellent access to major thoroughfares with proximity to cultural, commercial and leisure areas. The residential offer includes a total of 331 units, distributed between studios, 1-bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom units, each designed with spacious layouts, modern finishes and balconies that allow you to enjoy abundant natural light and panoramic views of the city or Dubai's iconic skyline. The residences feature high-quality materials, floor-to-ceiling windows and carefully planned interiors to maximise comfort, functionality and contemporary style. In addition, there is a fully equipped modern gym for daily physical training, garden areas and social spaces ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. The common spaces were designed to promote an uncompromised city living experience, with areas dedicated to socialisation, rest areas and a rooftop with panoramic views, providing a peaceful refuge in the middle of urban life. The prime location in Al Jaddaf allows quick access to iconic Dubai landmarks, including Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Dubai Creek, and efficient connections through major highways and metro stations, offering residents exceptional mobility. title: 58XX+M4, Dubai
description: Creek Haven by Emaar introduces an elevated waterfront lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets the tranquillity of nature. Offering a thoughtfully designed collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, the development combines sophisticated architecture, soothing water views, and abundant natural light to create homes that feel both inviting and refined. Each residence is carefully planned to maximize space, openness, and comfort, with modern interiors defined by clean lines, understated details, and a harmonious palette of soft tones. Generous layouts and expansive views capture the peaceful atmosphere of Dubai Creek Harbour, creating a private retreat where residents can unwind and enjoy a more balanced way of living. The development offers an impressive selection of resort-inspired amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social connection. Residents can enjoy separate adult and children's swimming pools, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, a padel court, dedicated yoga and relaxation areas, children's play spaces, and beautifully landscaped gardens. These thoughtfully curated facilities encourage an active outdoor lifestyle while creating a welcoming community environment. The apartments are offered unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their individual tastes and preferences. High-quality finishes, contemporary kitchens, refined materials, and carefully considered details provide an elegant foundation for modern living. Blending functionality with understated luxury, Creek Haven creates a living environment designed for comfort and lasting appeal. Location: Dubai Creek Harbour Dubai Creek Harbour is a landmark waterfront destination envisioned as a distinctive blend of contemporary architecture, natural beauty, and urban convenience. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, this master-planned community combines residential living with leisure, retail, and recreational experiences along the historic Dubai Creek. One of the area's standout attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach destination featuring approximately 700 metres of white sand, a resort-style atmosphere, and picturesque sunset views. The wider community is designed to offer a family-friendly environment, with landscaped promenades, open spaces, and opportunities to enjoy the waterfront lifestyle. Dubai Creek Harbour is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. The wider destination reflects Dubai's vision for innovative urban development, bringing together contemporary design, sustainability, and a vibrant waterfront setting. With its scenic surroundings, lifestyle attractions, and thoughtfully planned community infrastructure, Dubai Creek Harbour offers an appealing residential destination for homeowners and investors seeking modern waterfront living in Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

raw_area: Business Bay, Business Bay, Dubai, Dubai
description: Exclusive Fully Furnished Apartments in Business Bay Dubai Business Bay, Dubai's premier business and lifestyle hub, is a vibrant district that seamlessly blends luxury living with a thriving commercial environment. Known for its iconic skyline, Business Bay offers a mix of world-class residential towers, state-of-the-art office spaces, and high-end retail outlets. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it provides breathtaking waterfront views and easy access to major landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. With an array of fine dining restaurants, stylish cafes, and leisure destinations, Business Bay is a dynamic urban destination perfect for professionals, families, and investors seeking a modern and upscale lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street just 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera, 11 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project boasts a striking 102-floor tower with an iconic exterior crafted from high-quality materials, including premium marble, brushed gold detailing, and luxurious finishes such as white and gold marble and carbon fiber accents. Its design combines elegance and functionality with breathtaking aesthetics. Residents can enjoy over 40 premium amenities, including a private pool in every apartment, an infinity pool with canal views, a skyline spa, and a rooftop garden. It also features a wellness club, aquatic gym, indoor and outdoor party spaces, a sky meditation deck, and multiple lounges. Recreational facilities include a bowling center, mini-golf, cross-fit zones, a Zumba deck, a piano walk, and a musical deck. Sports enthusiasts can access cricket, badminton, basketball, and tennis training courts. Family-friendly features include kids' play areas, a trampoline zone, daycare, and a kids' oasis pool. Additional conveniences like a business center, library, beauty salon, health bar, and doctor-on-call services ensure a luxurious and well-rounded lifestyle. The project offers studios, one, two, three, four, and five-bedroom residences, featuring interiors that redefine luxury and elegance. Each unit is fully furnished with Exquisite Dolce Vita-branded furniture, crafted from premium Italian materials and showcasing meticulous attention to detail. The interiors include fitted wardrobes, stylishly designed to maximize space, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, blending practicality with sophistication. The living spaces are adorned with luxurious finishes, including marble flooring, fine wood accents, and high-thread-count linen curtains, while the bathrooms are enhanced with premium Italian fittings. Additionally, each residence is equipped with advanced smart home technology, providing seamless control of lighting, climate, and security to enhance convenience and modern living. Every element, from the convertible kitchens to the opulent grooved doors with golden details, embodies an exceptional standard of craftsmanship, creating an environment of unmatched comfort and refined beauty. description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. title: Iman One Park Square
description: One Park Square is a residential tower by Iman Developers in JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle). It rises 24 floors above a ground level and five podium floors, with retail units at street level. Homes include studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, duplex apartments on the 8th, 12th and 16th floors whose facade design includes a pool, and penthouses on the 24th floor. Studios start at 427 sq ft. Apartments come with equipped kitchens and open onto balconies. The first-floor amenity deck holds a 40-metre leisure pool with a pool bar, a kids' pool and splash pad, a jogging track, a skate park, a pet zone and barbecue areas. An indoor amenities level on the 11th floor adds a clubhouse with games, a fitness centre, a sauna, a steam room, an ice therapy room and an indoor children's play area with a climbing wall. Bluewaters Island is about 17 minutes away by car, Mall of the Emirates about 20 minutes, Dubai Mall 25 minutes and Dubai International Airport 30 minutes. JVC is a family-oriented community with parks, schools and medical facilities close by, and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road link it to the rest of the city. Iman Developers' earlier projects include Oxford Residences, Oxford 212, The Grove and One Park Central. Handover is expected in Q2 2028. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, and payments are held in a Dubai Islamic Bank escrow account.

description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. description: Luxury Waterfront Marina Apartments in Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain Siniya Island is a highly coveted natural gem in Umm Al Quwain. It combines an untouched coastal biodiversity with refined waterfront living. Celebrated for its tranquil mangrove forests, pristine white sandy beaches, and thriving native wildlife including gazelles, oryx, and flamingos, the island offers an extraordinary sanctuary along the Arabian Gulf. Surrounded by crystal-clear turquoise waters and protected ecological habitats, this serene island address provides a peaceful retreat from urban noise while establishing a dynamic destination for maritime leisure, waterfront activities, and high-yielding real estate investment. The enjoy outstanding regional connectivity via major Emirates highways E11 and E311, anchored by a landmark 1.7 km bridge that links the island directly to the mainland. Important coastal hubs, entertainment hubs, and commercial centers are within an easy drive. Al Marjan Island is 10 minutes away, Sharjah is within 30 minutes, and Downtown Dubai is 50 minutes away. This smooth transit network ensures effortless daily commuting and swift travel across the United Arab Emirates while preserving an intimate, private island atmosphere surrounded by tranquil sea breezes. Designed to deliver an extraordinary coastal resort lifestyle, the development features a wide range of social and maritime amenities. At its center lies a unique motorized seawater marina with private boat mooring, an exclusive yacht club, a waterfront shopping mall, a luxury boutique hotel, and a bustling dining promenade with cafes and restaurants. The amenity podiums host crystal-clear infinity swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, lush landscaped parks, outdoor play zones, relaxing co-working lounges, and an 18-hole championship golf course with sea views. The project features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with private balconies, ground-floor landscaped yards, or expansive sunlit terraces. Interiors include open-plan living and dining areas, fully fitted kitchens, guest powder rooms, utility spaces, and walk-in closets. Floor-to-ceiling glass windows and sliding doors maximize natural light while framing open sea views, shimmering marina canals, infinity pool, or green park landscapes. UAQ-00019

description: Binghatti Spectre is a distinctive mixed-use development by Binghatti, introduced under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." Rising above a shared podium, the development comprises two towers of contrasting heights defined by a sculptural and fluid architectural silhouette. The project brings together a selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Royal Suites, dedicated office spaces, and retail destinations, creating a contemporary environment that combines residential and commercial living with panoramic views across Dubai. Designed around an active and social lifestyle, Binghatti Spectre offers an extensive collection of leisure and wellness facilities. Residents can enjoy dedicated adult and children's swimming pools, a yoga and aerobics platform, paddle and tennis courts, and a jogging and sprint lane. Family-oriented spaces include a children's play area, comfortable sitting areas, and social nooks, while wellness facilities, lounge platforms, open lawns, and recreational tables including ping-pong provide opportunities for both relaxation and entertainment. The residences are thoughtfully planned across a range of layouts, from efficient studios to spacious three-bedroom homes. Larger residences offer enhanced features such as private pools, sky-open terraces, and dedicated laundry areas, creating a more elevated residential experience. Interiors are organized into distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites incorporated into the larger configurations. Modern finishes, quality materials, and contemporary detailing complete the homes, which are delivered unfurnished to allow residents to personalize their living spaces. Location Description & Benefits Located in Al Jaddaf , Binghatti Spectre benefits from an emerging waterfront neighborhood positioned along Dubai Creek. The area occupies a strategic location between the historic districts of Old Dubai and the city's established business and lifestyle destinations, including Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This central positioning provides convenient access to major road networks such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, while Dubai Metro and Creek transport connections further enhance accessibility. Al Jaddaf offers a distinctive combination of heritage, culture, waterfront surroundings, and modern urban development. The neighborhood is connected to Dubai Creek, one of the city's most historically significant waterways, while nearby cultural destinations add to its appeal. The Jameel Arts Centre contributes to the area's growing creative and cultural identity, creating an environment that extends beyond conventional residential living. The community continues to develop as a vibrant residential and commercial destination, with modern apartment buildings, waterfront residences, landscaped walkways, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport is another major advantage, particularly for frequent travelers and international residents. With its central location, growing waterfront appeal, strong connectivity, and proximity to Dubai's established business and lifestyle districts, Al Jaddaf offers attractive long-term potential for both end-users and investors. Binghatti Spectre combines this strategic setting with distinctive architecture, diverse residence options, and resort-style amenities, creating a contemporary destination designed for modern urban living.

title: HMB Beverly Grande
description: "Beverly Grande is developed by HMB Homes Real Estate Development in Motor City, within walking distance of First Avenue Mall and the Dubai Autodrome. The building has a basement, ground floor, ten upper floors and a roof level. It holds 296 apartments: 100 studios, 137 one-bedroom, 55 two-bedroom and four three-bedroom homes. Studios start from 412 sq ft, one-bedroom homes from 686 sq ft, two-bedroom homes from 1,095 sq ft and three-bedroom homes from 2,094 sq ft. Apartments are handed over unfurnished with fitted kitchens. Facilities are spread over three levels. The ground floor has a lobby, courtyards, a reading and business room and bicycle parking. The first floor adds a swimming pool with an inner beach area, a kids' pool and water play zone, an outdoor cinema, mini golf, a clubhouse and games room, an indoor wellness centre, an outdoor gym terrace and a jogging track. On the roof are a padel court, a mini basketball court, a barbecue area and a shaded cafe zone. Global Village is about 15 minutes by car, and Dubai Mall 25 minutes. description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. The combination of wellness facilities, recreational spaces, and social areas creates a balanced lifestyle with a distinct waterfront character. The residences feature contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, natural textures, and refined detailing. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. title: Ellington Portside Square
description:
Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. The scheme has three residential towers, named Portside Residences I, II and III, each with a ground floor, a podium, 16 residential floors and a roof level, and curved faÃ§ades drawn from the movement of wind and water. Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

Apartments are delivered with equipped kitchens and are otherwise unfurnished. Studios and one- and two-bedroom homes come with one parking space, and three- and four-bedroom homes with two. A first-floor amenity deck has a leisure pool, a kids' pool, cabanas, a running track, an outdoor fitness area and gardens. The pavilion adds a cinema and games lounge, an arcade, co-working pods, a spa with saunas and hot and cold plunge pools, yoga and Pilates areas, a fitness studio with a juice bar and a clubhouse. The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department. The payment plan asks for 20% on booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.
